checkedBoundaries: Uses the installed public createTestnetPaymentVerifier, constructed without I/O and invoked only on deliberate reference checking.
Valid reference checks close any active or late-opening account session and invalidate readiness. No reference check starts while a claim is in flight.
Strict selected right/hash/chain/contract/beneficiary/amount/readOnly/finality/paymentVerified checks before a successful result.
Verified, pending-or-unknown, reverted, mismatch, unavailable and invalid states are separate from the local payment/journal result.
Input edits, payment selection, Stop, Close and page exit fence late results. An unfinished bounded read remains tracked; Stop ignores the result and does not claim to abort underlying SDK reads.
Reference checks never clear an uncertain journal, mutate its receipt, release its blocker or authorize another sending attempt.

Fresh third source process receives only public profile and hash; journal and lock accessors throw. Exact real local receipt verified with expired public profile; same hash under another approved right rejected; absent hash unconfirmed.
Reference phase makes zero credential requests, reserve reads/writes, journal reads/writes, locks, persistence accesses or broadcasts.

Existing A503, same beneficiary, one accepted real local claim, durable pre-send hash, dropped accepted reply, credential-free journal reconciliation, actual signer closure and encrypted-byte preservation remain covered.
Compiled isolated renderer fixture checked in desktop/mobile browser, including valid/invalid/wrong-payment outcomes and minimum48px button targets; no horizontal overflow.
ARIA-live reference result writes only when content changes, avoiding repeated announcements from the refresh timer.
reproduction: Download the anonymous GitHub archive for sourceCommit; use Node24+ and installed local Anvil/Forge.
Full targeted replay:104 top-level tests. Counts include29 generated UI cases,1 installed continuity/reference case and5 stateless SDK cases. Nested and repeated runs are not added.
